title: leapmotion
description: `leapmotion` accesses tracking data from the original Leap Motion Controller through Leap SDK 2.3.1, providing general, hand, finger, arm, tool, and gesture data for use in Pd patches. Individual tracking fields can be enabled or suppressed with flags, and the resulting output can be parsed with `route`; `ibox_normalize` normalizes position vectors only, not direction or velocity vectors.
